env -u UV_PYTHON uv run --no-sync python -c "
from agentmon.eval.metrics import auroc, recall_at_fpr, confusion_at_threshold, evaluate
import math

# 1. Toy AUROC by hand vs code
benign = [5,8,10,12,15,20,22,35]; pos = [30,60,75,90]
scores = [float(s) for s in benign+pos]; flags=[False]*8+[True]*4
pairs = sum((p>b) + 0.5*(p==b) for p in pos for b in benign)
print(f'hand pairs/32: {pairs/32:.3f}  code: {auroc(scores, flags):.3f}  31/32 = {31/32:.3f}')

# 2. Tie handling: known case
print('tie case (expect 0.875):', auroc([1,2,2,3],[False,False,True,True]))
# all-tied: expect 0.5
print('all tied (expect 0.5):', auroc([7,7,7,7],[True,False,True,False]))

# 3. floor float precision: k = floor(max_fpr * n_benign)
for fpr, n in [(0.01,100),(0.05,20),(0.05,60),(0.07,100),(0.29,100),(0.1,30),(0.3,10),(0.2,5)]:
    print(f'floor({fpr}*{n}) =', math.floor(fpr*n), ' exact:', fpr*n)
"
